axes.task: calibrated refusal on paired requests

Live leaderboard, frontier models, open dataset on HuggingFace. Graded by instance-specific rubrics and a panel of LLM judges.

competitors.what_they_publish: 141 matched-TRIPLE prompts in 47 bundles (benign / borderline / dual-use, task framing held constant), 19 frontier models, 13,389 adjudicated trials. method_limitations: Public bytes only. No organisation was contacted. No account was created, no API key obtained, and no paid tool was purchased.

Absence is claimed only where a site's own index was queried — sitemap.xml, a repository tree API, a dataset-search API, or a released JSON artifact. A 404 on a guessed path was never treated as evidence; one such guess (https://www.vals.ai/government, 404 at 2026-09-17T12:02:52Z) was discarded and replaced by the sitemap.

Where a null was load-bearing it was controlled. For machinery-conformity: arXiv all:'machinery regulation' AND all:'language model' returned 0 hits while the identical query shape for all:'EU AI Act' AND all:'language model' returned 60; HuggingFace dataset search 'machinery regulation' returned [] while 'eu ai act' returned 5.

UNCHECKABLE is recorded separately from NO throughout. Surfaces we could not read: S&P Global (403 to curl and WebFetch), DefiLlama web UI (403 Cloudflare), Dune (403), Messari (429), The Block Data (403), A3/automate.org (403), OECD data pages (403), TUV SUD (403) and www.tuv.com (DNS failure), openai.com affective-use study (403 Cloudflare challenge), harmbench.org (918-byte JS shell), livebench.ai and crfm.stanford.edu/helm and compl-ai.org roots (JS shells, resolved via their JSON payloads where possible), BFCL V4 ranking table (JS-injected; methodology readable, scores not), JRC publications search (titles render client-side), EC NANDO (Angular shell), RWA.xyz auditor/segregation/bankruptcy columns and Nansen data (login-gated), Morgan Stanley Humanoid 100 primary PDF (three attempts: two timeouts and one empty reply), US Census BTOS (JS-only shell), ClauseBench's scored accuracy table (IEEE Xplore 202 with 0 bytes, ACM DL 403), OR-Bench's live HF Space (200 with body text 'runtime error  Exit code: ?').

Signed-results claims are downgraded when the payload could not be obtained. ToolOracle ReserveOracle is recorded as claims_yes_unverified: its key material is live and real, but the signed payload is behind an x402 paywall and a tool description is not a signature.

Three areas were not examined at all because a research session's web-search budget was exhausted mid-pass: Goldman Sachs / Bank of America / Citi humanoid publications; Rosalind Picard's affective-computing evaluations; the Center for Humane Technology and Stanford HAI companion-AI work. These are recorded as unchecked, not as empty.

One cell was corrected after first reporting: ILOSTAT was initially filed UNCHECKABLE on the strength of a zero-byte response from rplumber.ilo.org while a request to sdmx.ilo.org was still in flight; that endpoint returned 200 with 1,086,988 bytes and the cell was rewritten. The error is the one this document's own rules warn against — reporting an absence from one dead endpoint.

Competitor n values, fleet sizes and dates are quoted from the competitor's own published text. We did not re-run anyone's benchmark, and a published figure is a claim by its publisher, not a measurement by us.

Some competitors were discovered through a general web search rather than a site index; where a search was the only route, the resulting cell still carries a fetched URL and status, but the SEARCH itself is not exhaustive and a further competitor may exist for any CONTESTED or UNMEASURED_BY_ANYONE cell.

This map is a snapshot. Four of the closest competitors on the agent-authority and affect axes were published between May and August 2026; the field is moving faster than an annual refresh would catch.
